notes: Added missing stories to complete schema/contract, core routing loop, API integration, and test coverage.

FEAT-5-S120.title: Tool Schema Registry and Pydantic Contract Binding
FEAT-5-S120.description: Define and register all allowlisted tools with their corresponding Pydantic input models, ensuring each tool has a strict schema contract enforced at dispatch time.

FEAT-5-S121.title: Core Tool Routing Execution Loop
FEAT-5-S121.description: Implement the core routing loop that parses Anthropic tool_use blocks, maps tool names to allowlisted handlers, validates inputs via Pydantic, and invokes the appropriate domain service or facade.

FEAT-5-S122.title: FastAPI Integration for Tool Routing
FEAT-5-S122.description: Integrate the tool router into the FastAPI request lifecycle, ensuring chat requests trigger the tool-use loop and responses include tool outputs correctly merged into conversation history.

FEAT-5-S123.title: Unit Tests for Tool Routing and Validation
FEAT-5-S123.description: Create unit tests covering allowlist enforcement, schema validation success/failure cases, correct tool dispatch, and error handling paths.

FEAT-5-S124.title: End-to-End Tool Routing Integration with Domain Services
FEAT-5-S124.description: Validate end-to-end integration between tool router and domain services (provider search, clinical trials, consent, unknown handling), ensuring correct data flow and response composition.
